Merab took the first fight on wrestling and pace; Yan adjusted in the second and had his number from there. EXPLICITLY NOT THE BASIS: Merab's weight cut (that came from the app's simulation report, not the owner). summary: Owner fight-analysis principle, generalized from the Yan-Merab trilogy case (ref UFC333-YAN-20261024) and formulated with ChatGPT (relayed by owner 2026-10-24): MATCHUP-BASED CAUSAL REASONING — analyze how fighters interact, not just how good each looks individually. Method: (1) identify each fighter's primary path to victory; (2) look for evidence of tactical adaptation across previous matchups; (3) test whether one fighter has demonstrated the ability to neutralize the other's key strength (Yan, fight 2: defended Merab's takedowns over five rounds after losing fight 1 to wrestling/pace); (4) reassess the matchup that REMAINS if that strength is neutralized (a standing fight, where Yan's Muay Thai held a substantial edge); (5) combine with current statistics, striking/grappling data, and explicit uncertainty — prior-matchup evidence supports a hypothesis, it never guarantees a repeat. Calibration rule: preserve the tactical thesis with each prediction and grade this reasoning TYPE against outcomes across many fights, so the pattern earns or loses weight on its track record; one win does not canonize it. Companion to the Yan case record, whose grounded owner read carries weight per the owner's 2026-10-24 override.

summary: Owner GO (2026-10-24): MiroFish swarm-simulation lane starts, inside FUSION, weight ZERO until earned. MiroFish is an open-source AGPL-3.0 swarm engine (persona agents on a simulated social network, CAMEL-AI OASIS) - a crowd-convergence signal, sentiment family, not an outcome oracle. Independent evidence (OrcaLayer Polymarket test): swarm medians clustered 20-55, no clear signal - hence earn-your-weight. Weight policy: 0 until >=10 settled comparable sims AND >=55% directional hits (crowd lane bars), then capped 10% inside FUSION; the 5c approve bar reads FUSION without the sim until earned; sim never enters requote/shard/sizing math. Records: sim-run (seed-packet provenance, engine config, median lean, report link) + sim-outcome at settlement (hit/miss, distance), graded wins and losses, no cherry-picking. Server-side only, ~$0.40/run ceiling, one sim per market per card. AGPL: external process, never vendored into the proprietary repo.
